kingdom-puzzles.title: Kingdom Puzzles: Relaxing Brain Game
kingdom-puzzles.slogan: Challenge Your Mind with Kingdom Puzzles
kingdom-puzzles.description: Kingdom Puzzles is a relaxing brain game where you place kings on a grid, following specific rules. Each region can have only one king, and they cannot be in the same row, column, or adjacent tiles. Test your logic and strategy to win! Play Kingdom Puzzles now and enjoy the challenge.
